summary: Client only. Opens the game's character stage, with a figure dressed in the chosen look and a panel of choices. It does not change the player's body or send anything. characterCreatorChanged(appearance) follows every look the figure shows, and characterCreatorClosed(appearance, reason) gives your script the accepted look, { gender, body, head, hair, beard }, and null unless accepted. The reason is 'accepted', 'cancelled', 'closed', 'replaced', 'unavailable' or 'interrupted'. To apply it, send it to the server and call Player.setAppearance. For an editor of your own (a page or a NativeUI screen), open it with `panel: false` and drive the figure with preview, frame, accept and cancel; `choices` limits what can be chosen.

open.summary: Opens the creator, replacing one already open. Throws a TypeError for an unknown option or a part name list that is empty or too long, and a RangeError for a name that is no option of that part.

params.options: Optional: `genders` ('male', 'female' or 'both', the default), `title`, `appearance` to start from (by default the player's own), `panel` (false: no panel of choices, your own editor drives the figure) and `choices` ({ body, head, hair, beard }: each a list of the option names that part may be, '' for the game's own; a part left out offers everything). The panel and random looks keep to the choices.

open.exampleLua:
local Events = kcds.core.Events

kcds.ui.CharacterCreator.open({ title = "Who are you?", genders = "both" })

Events.on("characterCreatorClosed", function(appearance, reason)
  if reason == "accepted" then
    Events.toServer("saveLook", appearance)
  end
end)

close.summary: Closes the creator with the reason 'closed'. Returns false if it is not open.

look.summary: The look the figure shows now, { gender, body, head, hair, beard }, or null when the creator is not open.
look.exampleLua:
local look = kcds.ui.CharacterCreator.look()
if look then
  print(look.head)
end

preview.summary: Dresses the figure in a look, as a choice in the panel does: for an editor of your own. Parts left out are the game's own. Returns false when the creator is not open. Throws a TypeError for a malformed look and a RangeError for a part the catalogue does not have, a beard the face cannot wear or a gender the creator does not offer.

params.appearance: The look: { gender, body?, head?, hair?, beard? } with names from Appearances.

preview.exampleLua:
local Events = kcds.core.Events

kcds.ui.CharacterCreator.open({ panel = false, genders = "male" })
-- The server sends the looks your editor offers (Appearances is the server's catalogue).
Events.on("looks:try", function(look)
  kcds.ui.CharacterCreator.preview(look)
end)

frame.summary: Points the stage's camera at the whole figure ('body') or close at its face ('face'). Returns false when the creator is not open. Throws a TypeError for another frame.

accept.summary: Closes the creator with the look the figure shows: characterCreatorClosed hears it with 'accepted'. Returns false when the creator is not open.

cancel.summary: Closes the creator without a look: characterCreatorClosed hears null and 'cancelled'. Returns false when the creator is not open.
